svg.title: Client watcher, every day, 05:17 UTC
svg.desc: The steps in order, with who does each. Fetch: new release notes, docs of 3 AI clients; Claude Sonnet 5.5: checks every row of Kitden's list, with a quote; Reads Kitden's code: type and severity: major, medium, minor; Lantern: sure major: an issue now; others: Monday's summary; A second look: at a sure break or wrong data; You: confirm it, or close it as a false alarm.
